title: Mixed Conditionals 1-2-3 Writing-Satzbausteine U3/U4 ohne Travel Blog
designGoal: 100 gemischte Conditional-1/2/3-Satzbausteine fuer Klausur-Writing ohne Travel-Blog-Kontext. Alle Saetze sind als wiederverwendbare Writing-Bausteine fuer Opinion, Advice, Internship, Review, Report, Comment, Debate und Reflection kodiert.
exclusion: Travel blog contexts were intentionally excluded. Review/reflection/report contexts remain where they train argumentation, self-correction, advice or structured writing.

grammarRules.conditional3: If + past perfect, would/could/might have + past participle.

writingScaffoldRule: Every sentence is reusable as a sentence starter or support sentence in a later writing task. Use the mixed set for type identification and paragraph building.
